texts:
Serve or Sit for Week 5: the lineup calls you are stuck on, from Thursday night to the coin flips. KC and CAR are on bye.

Jacoby Brissett is up to QB8 for me.

Jalen Hurts falls outside my top 12.

Let's get to it.
#BirdGang #FlyEaglesFly

Thursday night, TB @DAL, 8:15 PM ET. Dallas is favored by nearly 10 and Baker Mayfield is out again.

Javonte Williams: 5 rushing TDs in four games, 3 at HOU. RB10 for me tonight.

George Pickens: 11 targets vs BAL. WR15 for me, a WR2.
#DallasCowboys #GoBucs

Bucky Irving: no catches vs GB and the short-yardage work went to Sean Tucker. RB23 for me, a low-end RB2.

Emeka Egbuka: a rookie QB went 19 of 27 for 148. WR41 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#GoBucs

Jake Ferguson: 3 TDs on 11 targets through Week 3, with CeeDee Lamb drawing 21 targets at HOU.
TE16 for me, a streamer; stream him tonight only if your tight end is on bye.
#DallasCowboys

The week favors them, quarterbacks.

Drake Maye: 3 TDs and 54 rushing yards at BUF. QB7 for me vs LV.

Jacoby Brissett: DET has given up the most QB points and the total is 53.5. QB8 for me.
#NEPats #BirdGang

Jayden Daniels practiced in full Wednesday on the elbow and Dan Quinn says a full Friday puts him back.
QB11 for me, a borderline start this week vs NYG.
#RaiseHail

The week favors them, running backs.

Bhayshul Tuten: out-snapped Chris Rodriguez Jr. 36 to 15 at CIN, two TDs called back. RB15 for me, an RB2.
#DUUUVAL

Emanuel Wilson: 21 carries and 2 TDs vs LAC, and Zach Charbonnet is ruled out for SF.
RB17 for me this week, an RB2.
#Seahawks

Braelon Allen: all 14 back carries at CHI, and Breece Hall missed Wednesday with the quad. RB20 for me, an RB2.

Will Shipley: 28 of 61 snaps and the last healthy back in Philadelphia. RB22 for me, an RB2.
#JetUp #FlyEaglesFly

The week favors them, receivers.

Carnell Tate: 12 targets at BAL, about 39 percent of the team's, for 9 and 145. WR22 for me, a WR2.

Romeo Doubs: 2 TDs at BUF, and Mack Hollins missed Wednesday. A high-end WR3 for me.
#TitanUp #NEPats

Denzel Boston: 95 percent of the snaps vs PIT and 52 percent of Cleveland's air yards.
WR29 for me, a high-end WR3, a high-end flex play.
#DawgPound

Tight ends, with Travis Kelce on bye.

Mike Gesicki: both Cincinnati receivers missed Wednesday's practice. TE11 for me, a borderline start @MIA.

Harold Fannin Jr.: 89 percent of the snaps vs PIT. TE12 for me, a borderline start.
#WhoDey #DawgPound

The week does not favor them.

Jalen Hurts: under 100 passing yards vs LAR, and his right tackle retired. QB15 for me; sit him for any QB in my top 12.

C.J. Stroud: 347 came against a leaky DAL defense. QB16 for me; sit him.
#FlyEaglesFly #HTownMade

Ja'Marr Chase: still in the concussion protocol and out of practice Wednesday. WR45 for me; sit him unless he is cleared Friday.

DJ Moore: doubtful with the shoulder. WR50 for me, a dart throw; sit him.
#WhoDey #BillsMafia

Marvin Harrison Jr.: 9 targets in Weeks 1 to 3 while Michael Wilson drew 30 in Weeks 3 and 4.
WR42 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; sit him for any receiver in my top 36.
#BirdGang

Alvin Kamara: 2 short TDs vs ATL, then no practice Wednesday with the back. RB25 for me; sit him for any back in my top 24 until Friday.

David Montgomery: 10 for 24 on 32 snaps vs DAL. RB28 for me; sit him for any back in my top 24.
#Saints #HTownMade

Tyler Allgeier: 8 for 42 and a TD, but Jeremiyah Love is still the lead. RB33 for me; sit him.

Keaton Mitchell: the most LAC touches in a three-way split. RB34 for me; sit him.

Woody Marks: 20 snaps to Montgomery's 32. RB35 for me; sit him.
#BirdGang #BoltUp #HTownMade

Jaylen Wright: 5 carries for 7 at MIN while Ollie Gordon II ran 9 for 100 on more snaps.
Outside my top 40 backs this week; sit him.
#PhinsUp

Coin flips, and Friday's injury report picks the side.

Jaylen Warren: 69 of 71 snaps at CLE. RB8 for me; the lean is to play him unless Rico Dowdle practices in full.

Kyle Monangai over D'Andre Swift: 30 carries for 146 after the fumble. RB18, an RB2.
#HereWeGo #DaBears

Jeremiyah Love: 14 for 63 on a tweaked ankle, in a 53.5 total. RB14, borderline RB1/RB2; lean play.

Cam Skattebo: limited Wednesday with the shoulder. RB19 for me, an RB2; lean play.
#BirdGang #NYGiants

Jordan Addison: missed Wednesday with soreness. WR25 for me, a high-end WR3; lean play unless he misses Friday.

Tyler Shough: limited with the left hand, says he will play. QB12 for me, a borderline start; lean play.
#Skol #Saints

Mark Andrews: Lamar Jackson is doubtful with the ankle, and the backup's five drives Sunday scored nothing.
TE13 for me, a borderline start, and the lean is sit for a streamer unless Jackson is active.
#RavensFlock

Every call with its numbers and what flips it is on the site, and Prep Notes updates the ranks Friday after the final injury report. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and like this if it settles a lineup.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/line.html?week=5
